title: I built this Replicator mechanic solo with AI. It got out of hand
author: PalpitationDry2576
selftext:
I am building Warbound Realms alone, with AI acting as the extra hands I cannot afford as a solo developer. This clip shows Mirror Image, a card that can overwrite adjacent allies after surviving a direct attack and then continue the replication chain.



The interesting part was not generating the first version. It was keeping the mechanic deterministic across CPU fights and real-player PvP while making every copied card preserve its current visual identity through attacks, movement, and death. I used AI throughout implementation, debugging, artwork iteration, and repeated contract testing, while I directed the mechanic, balance, presentation, and final decisions.



The result is this completely controlled and professional Replicator incident.



The browser alpha is free to play: [https://play.warboundrealms.com/](https://play.warboundrealms.com/)



For other AI-assisted solo developers, where has AI saved you the most time, and where has it created the most cleanup work?
